parameters.query:
INSERT INTO invoices (
  project_id, supplier_name, supplier_nif, invoice_number, invoice_date,
  base_amount, vat_amount, total_amount, vat_rate,
  category, trade_type, description, photo_url,
  ocr_summary, ocr_raw, ocr_confidence,
  llm_model, llm_tokens_in, llm_tokens_out, llm_cost, notes
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, NULLIF($5,'')::date,
  NULLIF($6,'')::numeric, NULLIF($7,'')::numeric, NULLIF($8,'')::numeric, NULLIF($9,'')::numeric,
  $10, $11, $12, $13,
  $14, $15::jsonb, $16,
  $17, $18::int, $19::int, $20::numeric, $21
) RETURNING id, supplier_name, total_amount, ocr_confidence, status, webhook_token, invoice_number, invoice_date, vat_rate, base_amount, vat_amount, category, trade_type;

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [

  $json.supplier_name || '',
  $json.supplier_nif || '',
  $json.invoice_number || '',
  $json.invoice_date || '',

  $json.vat_amount === null ? '' : String($json.vat_amount),
  $json.total_amount === null ? '' : String($json.total_amount),
  $json.vat_rate === null ? '' : String($json.vat_rate),
  $json.category || '',
  $json.trade_type || '',
  $json.description || '',
  $json.photo_url,
  $json.ocr_summary,
  JSON.stringify($json.ocr_raw),
  $json.ocr_confidence,
  $json.llm_model,
  $json.llm_tokens_in,
  $json.llm_tokens_out,
  $json.llm_cost,
  $json.notes || ''
] }}
